options.summary: Require a validity guardrail before accepting the branch.
evidence: Primary metric and validity guardrail are both checked.

taste_insight.expected_high_tail_value: A guardrail pattern may transfer to real automated-research benchmarks.
possible_negative_effects: May reject branches before useful debugging.

follow_up_checks: Run the toy evaluator with and without the guardrail.
